test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Higher Secondary Level) Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'BROWSE' is written as 'ZJMEIW' and 'ROAD' is written as 'JMAX'. How will 'BUDGET' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/30dbf680205b2ac5ef3c42da1ffec8619642030da36e21c43297a3224c70e079.png] 

The logic followed here is,

**'BROWSE' is written as 'ZJMEIW',**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2360f853ee0a75235ea36e602305bb90c114b6121a7d61c71acbdc06bb63a690.png] 

**'ROAD' is written as 'JMAX',**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6c073e73f351a2a52aa7be8dc82ab0455a91388d77f762c90614f94191e8c7f4.png] 

Similarly, for **'BUDGET'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4e983a182ceab4cbe56d0952702a5fcb1161f9849901d2d4746c1e0b94f81f19.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"ZGXUWH"**.
